column4: Hornet says, 'I'm sorry. Originally, I shouldn't have summoned you from another world.'

column4: 'I should have properly become the Demon King myself.'

column3: \tあの時はまだ力が無かったが、今なら不可能でないはずだと
column4: 'I didn't have the power back then, but now it shouldn't be impossible.'
